text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The challenge of the Classics begins<n>this year. I
decide to watch some TV<n>to see what our
competition looks<n>like.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
We have quite an interesting line up<n>for the
Classics this year.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
We have the peerless Sakura<n>Bakushin O in the
sprints. Rice<n>Shower has also announced her
intentions to compete, but...

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
There's no way she can beat Mihono<n>Bourbon,
who can potentially become<n>the Triple Crown
champion!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Mihono Bourbon is<n>leagues ahead of
the other racers<n>who debuted last year.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Hi, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Hi, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah. It's me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I wanted to come and wish<n>you a happy
New Year... Am I<n>interrupting something?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah... that's good.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Anyway, I talked to Urara this<n>morning.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She said she was going to make a<n>New Year's
resolution... and then she<n>asked if resolutions are
yummy.
choice_data_list: I... don't think they're very tasty.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Haha, me neither. That's what I told<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, anyway...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping that we could make our<n>resolution for
this year together...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping that we could make our<n>resolutions
for this year together...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Unless... you don't want to...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, yay! Now, what should my<n>goal be?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...What about you? What's your goal<n>for this year?
choice_data_list:
To make you a racer worthy of competing against
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...What about you? What's your goal<n>for this year?
choice_data_list:
To make you a racer worthy of competing against
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Actually...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is it okay if I make my goal the same<n>as yours?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Then it's decided.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to do my best to achieve<n>our goal.
choice_data_list: That's what I like to hear!
Be sure to keep your health in mind too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to do my best to achieve<n>our goal.
choice_data_list: That's what I like to hear!
Be sure to keep your health in mind too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right! I might not do well at first, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I won't ever give up.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: With that, Rice Shower makes a new<n>vow.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sigh... It would be just my luck tocatch a cold before a race.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And I don't want to miss out on<n>training with you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And I don't want to miss out on<n>training with you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh, I'll just have to be perfectly<n>healthy
forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Hearing the panic in her voice start to<n>rise, I quickly
work to calm her down<n>while we make a training
plan<n>together.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. You're kind of like a teacher.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. You're kind of like a teacher.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Heehee... I'm looking forward to your<n>next lesson...
Teacher.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Rice Shower and I watch<n>some race
footage together to study<n>up on Mihono Bourbon.
